title: Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**

  

Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology is responsible for developing and maintaining Private Capital specific programs and processes. Primary system is Private Capital Suite (fka Investran) and all the development tools associated with it. Design, develop, troubleshoot and improve change resilient application code and execute robust effective testing. Manage task and project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters. Flexibly work independently and as part of a team toward individual and team projects. From a product mindset perspective, engage in supporting applications (L2/L3\). Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance. Candidate will need to work afternoon shifts to support EMEA business users, including some weekend work when deploying code.

 **Experience/Skills**


Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Primary experience in dotnet and SQL stored procedures.
* Experience with project feasibility, definition requirements, design, testing and project delivery
* Experience with Agile project methodologies, CICD workflows, vulnerability management and issue remediation

Required Skills

* SQL
* dotnet
* REST APIs
* Terraform and IAAS
* Experience on working on Azure Cloud
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Work in a manner in keeping with the Northern Trust company’s core values
* Fast learner
* Self\-motivated

Preferred/ Recommended Skills:

* Experience in Private Capital and/or Financial industry
* PCS Live (fka Investran) experience
* Python
* Kafka
* Active Templates, Allocation Rules and Business Events
* ACCEL workflows
 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: HR Support Coordinator
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.


At Stantec, we have some of the world’s leading professionals passionate about enabling our business to be its best. Our business teams include finance, procurement, human resources, information technology, marketing, corporate development, HSSE, real estate, legal, and practice services. We bring diverse backgrounds, skills, and expertise and create a caring culture where everyone can thrive. Through teamwork and collaboration, we’re building a stronger, more resilient Stantec every day.


Your Opportunity


Build your HR career with Stantec in a role where your organizational strengths, customer service mindset, and attention to detail will contribute to effective HR service delivery. As an HR Coordinator, you will support essential HR administration activities, including employee record management, professional qualification validation, preparation of letters and employment verifications, and responses to internal and external inquiries. In this role you will apply your organizational and time management skills, communicate with employees and partners, and provide support across all levels of the organization while managing a variety of administrative priorities in a fast\-paced, highly computerized environment.


As part of a collaborative HR team, you will support HR partners and employees across multiple time zones and help deliver reliable, responsive service across the organization.


Your Key Responsibilities


* HR Service Center Support: Be a key point of support for HR programs and procedures by managing HR Service Center tools, HR information systems, and team inboxes to help employees and partners receive timely, efficient responses.


* Employee Records: Update and maintain employee records, including Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) certifications and employee life\-cycle changes.


* Employee Documentation: Prepare and coordinate time\-sensitive employee letters and related documentation.


* Employment Verification: Respond to external employment and income verification requests.


* Qualifications Administration: Verify professional qualifications and record them accurately in employee records.


* File Management: Maintain electronic employee files and fulfill document and file maintenance requests.


* Service Delivery: Deliver HR services in accordance with established processes, procedures, and operational metrics that support effective service and best practices.


* HR Administration Coordination: Coordinate with HR teams, Payroll, and third\-party vendors to resolve HR administration service requests promptly.


* May perform other administrative tasks as assigned, such as invoice coordination, and Talent Acquisition tasks.


Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Experience completing administrative tasks, including preparing letters, correspondence, and related documentation.


* Strong professional customer service skills, with the flexibility to attend meetings during North American time zone hours.


* Ability to follow standard methods and procedures to complete primarily transactional work assignments.


* Strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills.


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, paired with a professional attitude; Fluency in English is required for this role


* Ability to stay focused, manage concurrent deadlines, and maintain close attention to detail.


* Comfort working with diverse individuals at all levels across a geographically dispersed organization.


* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.


* Ability to exercise confidentiality, discretion, and sound judgment.


* Ability to learn new processes quickly and adapt to changing priorities.


* Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills; advanced Excel experience is considered an asset.


* Ability to work independently and consistently meet role objectives.


Education and Experience


* Minimum 5 years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.


Typical office environment—working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time.


This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that may be required of the employee; other duties, responsibilities, and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.


Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other’s talents, do exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us. Join us and redefine your personal best.

title: HR Operations Team Leader​
description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly\-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly\-Clark, it’s all here for you \- innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.


You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes people and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your HR operations leadership, judgment, and customer focus to lead a team delivering critical cross\-entity HR services. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


About You


In this professional role, based in Pune, you’ll lead the HR Operations Coordinator team and be accountable for the end\-to\-end implementation and consistent execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes. You will ensure coordinators understand the process, systems, decision rules, and service expectations required to manage requests accurately and efficiently.


You will oversee case dispatch and workload allocation, monitor service levels, manage escalations, coach the team, and maintain strong governance and audit readiness. Strong leadership, sound judgment, confidentiality, analytical thinking, and a customer service mindset are critical to success in this role.


Job responsibilities include:


* Own the implementation and end\-to\-end execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes in line with agreed design and governance.
* Ensure every coordinator understands the relevant processes, systems, decision rules, roles, and scope; onboard, upskill, and continuously coach the team.
* Assign and dispatch incoming cases to coordinators in ServiceNow, balancing workload and priority as team capability and volume evolve.
* Manage day\-to\-day operations including capacity planning, queue management, shift and holiday coverage, and backlog control.
* Monitor case volumes, turnaround times, quality, and service levels; report performance and act on trends before they become issues.
* Serve as the single escalation point for cross\-organization managers, HR Operations, Centers of Excellence, and HR Business Partner teams.
* Resolve or route complex and non\-standard cases, engage process owners when required, and communicate clear outcomes to stakeholders.
* Conduct quality reviews, provide regular feedback and development plans, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps promptly.
* Ensure delegated\-authority transactions are properly authorized, accurately documented, compliant, and audit\-ready.
* Safeguard sensitive and confidential employee information and ensure data privacy obligations are met across both companies.
* Identify recurring process gaps, operational risks, and system limitations, and partner with process owners on redesign and corrective action.
* Lead change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen service delivery and manager and employee experience.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:


Required Qualifications


* This is a fixed\-term contract lasting 18–24 months, with the shift running from 1:00PM to 10:00PM IST.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in HR Operations or HR Shared Services, including at least 2–3 years of experience leading or supervising a team.
* Proven experience implementing or stabilizing an HR process or service model, ideally within transformation, integration, or shared services.
* Solid end\-to\-end HR process knowledge across the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with case management tools such as ServiceNow, including queue management, case assignment, reporting, and SLA monitoring; working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Workday.
* Demonstrated ability to manage workload allocation, service levels, escalations, coaching, feedback, and performance for a distributed team.
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, problem\-solving, customer service, stakeholder management, and communication skills across levels and cultures.
* Proven discretion with sensitive employee data and sound understanding of data privacy, compliance, governance, and audit requirements.

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience working in a Global Business Services or HR Shared Services environment.
* Experience supporting global HR operations across different time zones and organizational cultures.
* Experience partnering with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, and non\-HR partner functions.
* Experience using operational data to identify process gaps, risks, service trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting HR transformation, integration, transition, or People Solutions activities.

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.


To Be Considered
  

  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.


In the meantime, please check out the careers website.


And finally, the fine print….


For Kimberly\-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world. We actively seek to build a workforce that reflects the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly\-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. We are a committed equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the Role:


We are seeking a skilled professional to lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of Trade Solutions and technical components that effectively support business objectives. The role partners closely with business and IT stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned with Ferrero's strategic priorities while delivering high\-quality outcomes. The successful candidate will manage assigned project streams, ensuring timely delivery, stakeholder alignment, and adherence to program milestones. They will proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application defects or performance issues, while maintaining a strong understanding of business drivers and operational needs. The position involves overseeing the full application lifecycle, from implementation through enhancement and eventual retirement, ensuring long\-term sustainability and value. Additionally, the role serves as a trusted technical advisor, collaborating with external partners and Run teams to ensure applications and supporting systems remain stable, efficient, and fully functional.


Main Responsibilities:


FUNCTIONAL \& TECHNICAL DESIGN


* Manages application/technical architecture components design (including enhancements) and makes sure they comply with the enterprise architecture and meet business needs
* Supports bringing new services into live by analyzing functional/non\-functional requirements, developing technical architecture options and recommendations
* Establishes time schedules with Operations and partners/3rd parties to implement the required technologies, skills and procedures
* Supervises impact analyzes of any upgrade with regards to technical aspects and data, and facilitates smooth transition from existing version to the new version
* Manages application/technical components lifecycle, from development and configuration to maintenance
* Manages any data migration exercise and ensures data consistency
* Manages the decommissioning of redundant applications/hardware/infrastructure aligned with roadmap
* Works with Service Lead and Service Management to support achievement of Service level targets


**CONFIGURATION**


* Prepares and implements Deployment/Configuration Designs
* Maintains up\-to\-date inventory, asset and configuration information


**TESTING**


* Lead testing efforts for large and complex applications/technical architecture components
* Create test plans and schedules
* Create and implement test cases on project requirements
* Report defects and escalate issues
* Interact with team throughout development process
* Troubleshoot new builds and post production issues
* Follow and analyze issues gathered in bug tracking system
* Edit and support solution documentation
* Review reports for accuracy and determine discrepancies


**PROJECT MANAGEMENT**


* Manages the delivery of the application/technical architecture component solutions (improvements, enhancement, upgrades) to ensure alignment to demand requirements and Service Level Agreements targets, while maintaining coherence within the overall architecture


**SERVICE MANAGEMENT**


* Is responsible for level 3 support.
* Ensures any issues related to applications, interfaces or infrastructure performance and availability is solved as per the agreed Service Level Agreements
* Manages incidents and problems (level 3 support)


About You:


We are looking for a Trade Promotion Management professional with 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience, preferably within the FMCG/Consumer Goods industry and exposure to international business environments.



The ideal candidate should possess a Bachelor's degree (Master's degree is an added advantage) and strong expertise in trade promotion, customer planning, forecasting, and related SAP TPM applications.



A solid understanding of business processes, commercial operations, and multi\-application planning and execution environments is essential.



The role requires strong project management capabilities in an IT\-driven environment, along with experience supporting multi\-level helpdesk operations.



Candidates should be highly analytical, proficient in Excel, and comfortable working with data to drive business decisions and process improvements.



We value team players who are flexible, result\-oriented, excellent communicators, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of **Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946\.** Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet\-packaged food companies, with many **iconic brands** sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.
